assets.title: Independent Fork-End Aircraft Towbar
assets.description: Original independent static ground-handling towbar with two thick fork eyes and genuine transverse through-holes, paired continuous fork arms, a solid crosshead, a finite bored shaft sleeve, a long inclined shaft and a two-grip T handle. Two front skids and one connected rear parking leg provide three finite ground patches. A separate raised red collar visually identifies the fixed sleeve seat. Four solid PBR materials, named editable closed components, metres, source Z up and ground-centre origin. One reusable prop, no scene or external textures. The existing plane is tailwheel-equipped; its final normalised mesh interface was not fitted or tested. This independently sized visual connector does not claim compatibility with that plane or any real aircraft. No towing power, steering or locking operation, animation, load capacity, operating procedure, airworthiness or safety certification.
